name: Chocomaru
source:
Race: Female cat
Origin: Jesse Express
Hobby: Moving things
Job: Pilot, receptionist

The legendary black cat who is in charge of Jesse Express, the best moving company in the Universe. With IQ over 180, she is ready to deliver anything!
